items.title: Cencora (COR) Expands Credit Facilities And Resets Receivables Terms
items.summary: Cencora (NYSE:COR) has amended its credit and receivables facilities, including changes to its multi currency revolving credit facility and receivables securitization arrangements. The company has adjusted the size and maturity profile of its revolving credit facility and updated terms related to its receivables securitization structure. items.title: Cencora’s (NYSE:COR) Q2 CY2026 Earnings Results: Revenue In Line With Expectations
items.summary: Healthcare distributor Cencora (NYSE:COR) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 5.1% year on year to $84.75 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.48 per share was 3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
